hero_subtitle: Explore how Norfolk County Council manages public money.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

spend_triangulation.note: Quarterly CSV (2023) + monthly XLSX (2024+) feed via Cloudflare-protected /article/39418/Payments-to-suppliers (ingested via Chrome MCP browser automation 4 May 2026). Norfolk includes Pension Fund + P-card transactions in the same feed. After classification: £91M statutory pass-through (7 Norfolk districts + NHS trusts + ICB), £253M internal transfer (Norse Care Ltd LATCo + NCC self-payments), £19M direct payment to individuals (REDACTED + foster/care payments). Pre-2023 corpus pending (live page only links Apr 2023+; older years on archive page behind separate Cloudflare challenge — re-run Chrome MCP fetch with archive page next iteration).
